versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for fast fetching of public Douyin data.
- Supports four core functions: keyword search, bulk author content fetch, video comment retrieval and analysis, and real-time trending topics.
- Triggered for tasks involving Douyin search, trending topics, comments, author posts, competitor analysis, or short video research—even if "Douyin" is not explicitly mentioned.
- Outputs structured JSON data for use in research and analysis workflows.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN by environment variable; includes robust token management and error handling protocols.
- Command-line usage with clear parameter mapping and limits; all commands support --help for usage guidance.
